title: When the Hymn Falls
author: Ivo Delacroix
blurb: Oscar Montrose, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
